# mtncloud_managed_kubernetes_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up one Kubernetes cluster by ID or by name, including one made in the console. A managed Kubernetes cluster, built with `mtncloud_managed_kubernetes_cluster` or in the console. A name must match exactly one Kubernetes cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_managed_kubernetes_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "k8s-prod"
}

output "api_url" {
  value = data.mtncloud_managed_kubernetes_cluster.prod.api_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the Kubernetes cluster. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes cluster, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) Kubernetes API address, or empty.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud the cluster is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the cluster belongs to.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `layout` (String) Layout the cluster was built from, for example `MTN Kubernetes HA (3)`.
- `node_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the cluster's nodes (masters and workers; Docker: hosts).
- `status` (String) Status, for example `ok`.
